arc: hook (referral link copied out of the URL bar) → integrations (shared to Telegram/X/Discord) → concept (two-tier referral tree) → benefit (tiers compress into 'for life') → data (tilted rewards dashboard glide) → logo (mark ignites, word types on)

scenes.title: URL bar with unlocking padlock, typed referral code and clicked copy button
scenes.summary: Fades up from black on a dark grid: a black pill URL bar reading 'losses.trade/regrets?ref=' beside a padlock tile, with a bracketed HUD label 'REGRETS' and 'NOW SELF-INFLICTED' typing on at bottom right. The padlock swings open with a red flash and the tile turns yellow→red gradient, then squashes into the caret; the code 'rekt' types in yellow behind a gradient caret. The camera pushes in to ~1.86x onto a gradient 'Panic sell' button framed by hairline guides, a hand cursor clicks it (gold coins burst outward with a camera shake), and the button detaches as a tilted capsule flying to centre for the next scene. Straight copy in components/copy.ts ORIGINAL reads 'gains.trade/referrals?ref=alpha', 'REFERRALS / NOW SELF-SERVE', 'Copy link'.
scenes.build: Orthographic-feel perspective camera at 1 unit = 1 px (pxCamera); the URL bar/lock/button live in a 'stage' group whose scale and x are driven by kf() keyframe arrays to fake camera push/pans. Text is canvas-texture Txt with reveal(n) cropping for typewriter, HudLabel draws bracketed boxes that grow as they type, PixelField instanced cells flicker around the lock and button. Shared atmosphere() from components/fx.ts adds falling embers, film grain, vignette and impact shake/flash on listed hit times; coinRain() is instanced lit metallic coins with closed-form ballistic flight.
scenes.reuse: Borrow for any 'grab your link / invite code / API key' opener or a copy-to-clipboard click moment: swap the URL base and code in copy.ts, the HUD title, the button label, and the yellow/red palette in brand.ts. The keyframed stage-zoom-onto-button with a hand-cursor click and coin burst is the reusable idea. Don't copy the parody copy ('Panic sell', 'REGRETS') unless you want the joke; ORIGINAL is the straight version.

scenes.title: Glowing orb fans out to Telegram, X and Discord globes, then tilts into 3D
scenes.summary: The 'Panic sell' capsule from scene 1 shrinks into a yellow/red gradient orb with concentric grey halos that thump like a heartbeat. The network spins in from 100° as three spokes draw out to wireframe lat/long globes with circular Telegram, X and Discord icon badges; glowing yellow packets travel along the spokes. A bracketed HUD types 'TELL NO ONE' (straight copy: 'SHARE IT ANYWHERE'). The whole network then tilts back ~45° into 3D and pushes in while a red earnings box '$ -1284.00 ↓' counts down on the left and gold coins pour out of it, before everything falls away into the dark.
scenes.build: Nested groups outer (screen spin) → tilt (rotation.x for the 3D lay-down) → spin (network rotation) so each move is one transform. wireGlobe() and orb()/badge() in components/network.ts; Polyline.draw(t) draws spokes on and pointAt(k) moves packets along them; Counter renders the changing number from a pre-drawn glyph atlas so it can update every frame. Icons are SVGs loaded via TextureLoader(ctx.manager). Heartbeat is a sum of two gaussian bumps per 0.8s cycle applied to halo scale/opacity.
scenes.reuse: Use for 'share it anywhere', 'works with your channels', 'publish to every platform' beats: swap the three SVG icons and the spoke count, change the HUD text and the counter target. The hub-and-spoke with travelling packets plus the tilt-into-3D push is the takeaway. Drop the falling-coins and down-arrow loss gag for a straight version (turn the counter green and positive).

scenes.title: Two-tier referral tree with commission packets and a punch-in on the number
scenes.summary: A white-outlined pill 'You' draws on left-to-right and a red balance starts counting down beside it ('$ -…'). Elbow connectors draw down to a gradient pill 'Paper hands' and then to 'Bagholder' (straight copy: L1 / L2); yellow and red return links draw back up to You with tags '-10%' and '-5%', and glowing packets with trails run along them. The camera pushes, punches hard into the counting number (2.6x, with a pixel glitch), then pulls back to the full tree as HUD labels type 'Lose 10% of their fee' and '5% of everyone they drag down'. Coins leak out of the balance throughout.
scenes.build: Whole tree is one group whose scale and offset follow a [t, s, ox, oy] keyframe table (K) — a 2D 'camera' without moving the camera. Connectors are Polyline elbows drawn with draw(t); runPacket() places a glow+core+trail along a polyline with pointAt() and swaps the trail orientation per segment. Pills come from ui.ts pill() with gradient fills L1_FILL/L2_FILL shared with scene 4; Counter for the ticking balance, HudLabel for the typed explainer; atmosphere() + coinRain() from fx.ts.
scenes.reuse: Good for explaining any tiered or hierarchical relationship: referral programs, team/org trees, parent-child accounts, upstream/downstream flows. Swap the pill labels, percentages and the explainer lines in copy.ts; keep the draw-on connectors, travelling packets and the punch-in on the key number. The draining-coins and negative counter are part of the parody.

scenes.title: Wall of tier pills compresses into one locked block — 'for life'
scenes.summary: Opening close on the two pills scene 3 ended on, dozens more 'Paper hands' / 'Bagholder' pills pop in radiating outward and rows drift in alternate directions as the view pulls back to a six-row wall. A yellow bar drops in and every row slides right into it, flattening into a single gradient block of striped rows; a padlock tile slams down from the camera onto it. HUD labels type 'Haunts you' and 'for life' (straight copy: 'Bound to you / for life'). In the last frames the glowing edge of the dashboard card swings up out of the dark from bottom right as the handoff.
scenes.build: Pills are cloned meshes sharing two prototype geometries/materials; each pill's appear time is its distance from the focus point, giving a ripple-out reveal. Framing uses sk() Hermite-spline keys (rig.ts) for scale/offset. Compression lerps each pill toward the bar with per-row stagger while canvas-drawn block slices scale in on x. The padlock 'slam' is a z offset from 600 to 0 with rotation. Dashboard edge uses applyPose/poseAt(DASH_ENTRY) shared with scene 5.
scenes.reuse: Use for a 'everything consolidates into one place' / 'all your X, unified' / 'locked in forever' beat: replace the two pill labels and colours, the two HUD lines, and the lock icon. The ripple-out wall then compress-into-a-bar move is the transferable idea. Cut the dashboard-edge handoff if the next scene isn't the dashboard.

scenes.title: Tilted 3D glide over a rewards dashboard with live counters, then flat close-ups
scenes.summary: A black dashboard card with a glowing yellow edge swings up out of the dark from the bottom right, a glass sheen sweeps it, and its content surfaces: wallet header '0×DEAD ... BEEF', four stat cards (Total Unrecoverable, Vaporized Volume, Friends Remaining, Your Rate '-10% / -5%'), a 'Regret link' panel and a 'Penalties' rewards row. The camera glides down it tilted in 3D while every number counts in red, stat cards flash as it passes and a 22-bar loss chart grows. It then cuts to flat close-ups: the header, the rewards row (chart regrows), and the 'People who blame you' table whose type badges stamp in row by row with a yellow flash. Straight copy (ORIGINAL) is a normal referral dashboard: Total Unclaimed, Referred Volume, Rewards, Claim on Arbitrum.
scenes.build: The real work is components/dashboard.ts: buildDashboard(T) lays the whole UI out in its own 2408×2880 pixel space and draws it once into two big canvases (top half and table), with counting numbers (Counter), chart bars and type badges as separate meshes on top with fixed renderOrder so the tilt never hides them. The camera move is components/rig.ts: poseAt(R, DASH_TILT / DASH_FLAT) Hermite-splines a pose (focus point → screen point, scale, rx/ry/rz) and applyPose() places the pivot. The scene file only drives counters, flashes, chart growth and the sheen().
scenes.reuse: Borrow for any 'here's your dashboard' feature shot: a tilted fly-over of a whole app screen, then flat crops on the parts that matter. Rewrite the layout in dashboard.ts for your product's UI and the strings in copy.ts dash, and retune the pose keys in rig.ts. Don't keep the parody labels or the red loss colouring for a real launch.

scenes.title: Mark ignites in a pixel frame, word types on with a block caret
scenes.summary: A dim mark sits centred on black and ignites to full white with radial god rays, an expanding yellow shockwave ring, a red bloom and a flickering stepped ring of pixel cells around it. The mark slides left and the word 'losses' types on beside it at large size with a chunky yellow block caret, then 'losses.trade/regrets.' types underneath with a thin blinking caret (straight copy: 'gains' / 'gains.trade/referrals.'). Gold coins keep raining slowly far behind the lockup.
scenes.build: Mark is a PNG texture on a plane whose material colour lerps dark→white on ignite; rayBurst() in fx.ts is a shader plane of hashed radial beams plus a RingGeometry shockwave. The pixel frame is a canvas of hairline cell outlines plus a PixelField of the same cells. Typing uses Txt.reveal(n) with the caret placed by widthAt(n); timings run on a clock pulled 0.8s earlier (S = R + 0.8) to land the ignite on the music pulse.
scenes.reuse: A ready logo sting for any dark, techy brand: replace assets/gains-mark-loss.png, the outroWord and outroUrl in copy.ts, and the bloom/ray colours. Lose the coin rain unless coins fit the product.
